review_scope: Black with very subtle tonal print sampled from an unbranded upper-side patch and interrupted gold central torso stripe, gold/black round ring. Fold/arm-obscured print simplified. Independently evidenced away reference selected from the full club history. Actual source season and event/version labels retained. Colors estimated from the source, with fine print and obscured regions adapted to the common silhouette. Original PNG alpha, fabric and physical round collar preserved; emblems, sponsors, manufacturer symbols and lettering excluded.
limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
